content.title: Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release schedule: when is episode 6 on Disney Plus?
content.text: (Image credit: Marvel Studios) The Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release schedule hasn't exactly been predictable this year, with a double episode drop early doors leading to some confusion about how many episodes to expect each week, and when. But (man without) fear not, we're here to make sure you never miss an episode.And after that thrilling trip to the past in episode 5, Daredevil: Born Again season 2 is firing on all cylinders. Less so Matt's floppy wig, but the less said about that, the better. What does the rest of the season have in store? There's not long to find, with only three episodes to go.Article continues below Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release date: what time is episode 6 streaming on Disney Plus? (Image credit: Marvel Studios)Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 6 releases on April 21, 2026, at 6:00 PM Pacific/9:00 PM Eastern on Disney PlusThat's 2 AM BST on April 22, for those across the pond in the UK. For help with other regions, you can use this handy time zone converter.Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release schedule: when are new episodes out? (Image credit: Disney Plus)A new episode of Daredevil: Born Again season 2 will hit Disney Plus every Tuesday until early May, with a total of eight episodes.The full Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release schedule is as follows:Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 1: March 24, 2026 - out now!Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 2: March 31, 2026 - out now!Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 3: March 31, 2026 - out now!Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 4: April 7, 2026 - out now!Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 5: April 14, 2026 - out now!Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 6: April 21, 2026Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 7: April 28, 2026Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 8: May 5, 2026Where to watch Daredevil: Born Again season 2 (Image credit: Disney)Daredevil: Born Again season 2 is available to watch exclusively for all Disney Plus subscribers. While the first three seasons of Daredevil were produced and released by Netflix, Born Again brought Daredevil into the MCU officially and is part of Disney's own streaming service.For more, check out our Daredevil: Born Again season 2 review, or check out our guide on how to watch the Defenders Saga in order.
